title: TableControl: Gesture Interaction Through Surface Vibrations
abstract: arXiv:2611.24218v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Integrating gesture sensing into furniture offers a way to interact with digital applications and physical devices through familiar surfaces. We present TableControl, an interactive demonstration of continuous surface-vibration-based gesture recognition with the complete processing pipeline running on a microcontroller. Using four concealed piezoelectric sensors, the system combines signal acquisition and preprocessing with neural event detection and gesture classification. The resulting labels for knock, swipe-up, and swipe-down gestures are transmitted to a host computer without streaming the underlying sensor signals. Visitors explore two example applications through hands-on interaction: an endless runner game and a physical table lamp with on/off and brightness control. A dashboard displays recognized gestures, class probabilities, and processing times.

translated_title: TableControl：基于表面振动的手势交互
translated_abstract: 将手势感知集成到家具中，提供了一种通过熟悉的表面与数字应用和物理设备进行交互的方式。我们展示TableControl，一个基于连续表面振动的手势识别的交互式演示，其完整的处理流程运行在微控制器上。该系统使用四个隐藏的压电传感器，将信号采集与预处理同神经事件检测和手势分类相结合。识别出的敲击、上滑和下滑手势标签被传输到主机电脑，而无需传输底层传感器信号。访客通过动手实践探索两个示例应用：一个无尽跑酷游戏和一盏支持开关与亮度控制的实体台灯。仪表板实时显示识别出的手势、类别概率和处理时间。
tldr: 本文提出TableControl系统，在微控制器上运行完整的处理流程，利用四个隐藏的压电传感器实现基于表面振动的连续手势识别，可识别敲击、上滑和下滑手势并驱动游戏和台灯等实际应用，且无需传输原始传感器信号。
en_tdlr: TableControl demonstrates continuous surface-vibration-based gesture recognition with a complete processing pipeline running on a microcontroller, using four concealed piezoelectric sensors to detect knock, swipe-up, and swipe-down gestures for controlling real applications without streaming raw sensor signals.
